description: This file defines an interface for building responses to the RetrieveFeatureProperties command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies methods for creating success and error response objects related to feature property retrieval.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface extending LiveCommandAnswerBuilder for building command response responses specifically for RetrieveFeatureProperties commands.

methods.name: retrieved
methods.description: Creates and returns a RetrieveFeaturePropertiesResponse containing the feature properties retrieved.

parameters.name: featureProperties
parameters.description: The feature properties object to include in the successful response.

methods.name: featurePropertiesNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates and returns a ThingErrorResponse indicating that feature properties are not accessible, either because they do not exist or due to insufficient permissions.
